summary: One tagged message is now one Langfuse trace, and the Standing fold is traced for the first time.
details: The tag path opened three spans with no parent, and a rootless span is its own trace — so a single tagged message produced three near-empty engagement traces beside ingest's. They now nest under one root per tag, with the turn's outcome, delivery, stop reason and latency recorded on it.
A queued tag joins the trace that admitted it. Its trace context is captured at admission and re-attached when the queue dispatches it, so it is never filed under the tag ahead of it in the queue.

The Standing debrief's model call — previously the only model call with no instrumentation at all — appears as a generation with its model, prompt, output and finish reason, as a child of the tag's trace. The consolidate retry gets its own generation.
Identifiers and coordinates are screened out of anything sent to the tracing collector, using the same egress predicates that already guard Nora's replies and her Dreamer writes.
limitations: The trace-side screen is whole-text: one coordinate anywhere in a fold's prompt withholds the entire prompt from the trace. A digest of the real prompt and the tag id are still recorded, so the fold stays re-derivable against the retained trace, but it is not readable inline in that case.
